description: This file defines a PHP trait 'LayoutEntityHelperTrait' that provides helper methods for managing layout entities within Drupal's layout builder module, including retrieving section storage, checking entity compatibility, and handling inline block components.

methods.name: isLayoutCompatibleEntity
methods.description: Checks if an entity can have a layout by verifying if section storage exists for it.

methods.name: getInlineBlockRevisionIdsInSections
methods.description: Retrieves revision IDs for inline block components within given sections.

methods.name: getEntitySections
methods.description: Returns layout sections associated with an entity, if any.

methods.name: getInlineBlockComponents
methods.description: Filters and returns components that have Inline Block plugins from sections.

methods.name: getSectionStorageForEntity
methods.description: Retrieves section storage for an entity based on its context and view mode.

methods.name: originalEntityUsesDefaultStorage
methods.description: Determines if the original entity used the default section storage during save.

methods.name: sectionStorageManager
methods.description: Provides the section storage manager service.

methods.name: getOverridesSectionStorageForEntity
methods.description: Gets the overrides section storage for an entity with overridden layout.

methods.name: getSectionStorageContextsForEntity
methods.description: Builds context array for section storage based on entity and view mode.
